final_answer:
The chain for %CAR+ is mostly intact, but it has three weak points. The EMS alarm-escalation requirement has stale verification. The timing risk has no test evidence. The open ENG deviation probably has the wrong root cause. All five PPQ batches passed.

**1. Attribute and measurement**
- %CAR+ is `FC-CAR`, a CQA in the semantic layer's `transduction_efficiency` entity. It is not the day-5 in-process value.
- Method `AM-FC-CAR` is flow cytometry, with a validated range of 5–90 % of CD3+ and status VALIDATED.
- Protocol `AMV-FC-CAR-01` (approved 2026-03-02, report approved) validated it. Its test case `TC-AMV-CAR-01` is SCRIPTED and covers 5–90 %. Execution `TX-0086` passed on 2026-03-20.
- The PPQ range of 36–45 % and the ENG results of 12–20 % all sit inside the validated range.

**2. Parameters that drive it**

| Parameter | Criticality | PPQ-001 criterion | PPQ batch values |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI | CPP | 4–6 TU/cell | 5.0 on every batch |
| Time from activation to transduction | CPP | 20–30 h | 21.9–23.7 h |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none | not evaluated |

- PPQ-001 criterion 8 is %CAR+ ≥ 20 % of CD3+.
- Vector storage temperature has no PPQ criterion, so it is a gap in PPQ coverage.

**3. Risks, controls and test evidence**

| Risk | Rating | Mitigated by | Test evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FM-06` MOI below target | HIGH, sev 8 | `URS-EBR-007` (vector volume calculation) and `SOP-MFG-104` | Verified: `TC-OQ-EBR-04` (SCRIPTED) passed as `TX-0083` on 2026-03-17, with no later change control. |
| `FM-07` vector held above −70 °C | HIGH, sev 8 | `URS-ULT-001`, `URS-ULT-002`, `URS-EMS-014`, `SOP-MAT-401` | `URS-ULT-001` and `URS-ULT-002` are verified (see below). `URS-EMS-014` is stale. |
| `FM-08` transduction outside 20–30 h | MEDIUM, sev 6 | `SOP-MFG-104` only | None. No requirement or test case is linked. |
| `FM-15` OOS result not flagged | HIGH, sev 10 | `URS-LIMS-002`, `URS-LIMS-003` | Verified: `TC-OQ-LIMS-02` (`TX-0074`) and `TC-OQ-LIMS-03` (`TX-0075`) passed in February 2026, with no change control. |

- **ULT freezer requirements:** The OQ and PQ test cases are `TC-OQ-ULT-01`, `TC-OQ-ULT-02` and `TC-PQ-ULT-01`. Compressor replacement `CC-26-014` on `FRZ-80-02` was implemented on 2026-04-23. The OQ was re-run on 2026-04-24 and passed (`TX-0091`, `TX-0092`). That makes both requirements currently verified.
- **Weak spot in the ULT evidence:** The loaded-mapping PQ for `FRZ-80-02` (`TX-0044`, 2026-02-12) predates the compressor replacement and has not been repeated.
- **`URS-EMS-014` (escalation to on-call within 15 min):** Its only test, `TC-OQ-EMS-04` (`TX-0070`), passed on 2026-01-20. `CC-26-011` changed the escalation configuration (`CS-EMS-03`) on 2026-03-16 and declared "no re-testing required". The last pass therefore predates the change, so the verification is stale. This is a HIGH-risk requirement (`FRA-027`).
- **`FM-08`:** The only control is `SOP-MFG-104` and the batch-record timing check. PPQ-001 does measure the timing (criterion 5), so there is PPQ data but no verification test.

**4. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, execution complete, report pending)**

| Batch | %CAR+ | VCN per CAR+ cell (≤ 5.0) | Vector lot |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PPQ26-01` | 44.6 | 2.39 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-02` | 39.2 | 2.23 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-03` | 36.1 | 1.79 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-04` | 38.9 | 1.87 | `LV26-021` |
| `PPQ26-05` | 37.3 | 2.22 | `LV26-021` |

- All five met the ≥ 20 % criterion and all VCN results passed.
- The calculated effective MOI is 5.00 on every PPQ and ENG batch. That calculation uses the CoA titer, so it can't show a loss of potency.

**5. Related deviations and what connects them**
- **`DEV-26-021` (MAJOR, closed):** The `FRZ-80-02` compressor failed.
  - The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40 by warehouse staff, about 11 h later. The EMS requirement is 15 min.
  - The historian shows the chamber warming from about −71 °C to −36 °C before the contents were moved to `FRZ-80-01` at 15:30.
  - The deviation resulted in `CAPA-26-008`, which was implemented by `CC-26-014`.
  - The alarm response is the same function as the stale `URS-EMS-014`. `CC-26-011` rebuilt the escalation groups five weeks earlier with no re-test.
  - The deviation has no link to any lot, and no lot was put on hold.
- **`DEV-26-027` (ATYPICAL_RESULT, open) and `CAPA-26-016`:** `ENG26-01` (19.8 %) and `ENG26-02` (11.9 %) came in low. `ENG26-03` (13.9 %) was also low but isn't named in the deviation.
  - The stated cause is donor variability.
  - All three ENG runs used vector lot `LV25-118`, which was stored in `FRZ-80-02`.
  - The PPQ batches used lots stored in `FRZ-80-01`.
  - Donor CD3 does not explain the difference. `PPQ26-04` had the lowest CD3 (50.1 %) and still gave 38.9 % CAR+.
  - A more likely cause is potency loss in `LV25-118` from the `DEV-26-021` excursion. Its CoA titer (104 × 10⁶ TU/mL) was not re-tested. This is my inference from the data, not something the records state, and it should be investigated.
- **`DEV-26-033` (PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, closed):** `PPQ26-02` missed the harvest viability criterion after an `INC-03` door was left unlatched. It also links to `CAPA-26-015`, whose effectiveness check is still pending. `PPQ26-02` still passed %CAR+, at 39.2 %.
- **`CAPA-26-012` (open):** `INC-03` also failed its door-alarm qualification test (`DEV-26-011`), and this CAPA is still open past its 2026-03-31 due date.
- **`DEV-26-038` and `DEV-26-041`:** These are a label printer error on `PPQ26-04` and a tubing set leak on `PPQ26-05`. Neither relates to %CAR+. `DEV-26-041` and `CAPA-26-019` are still open.
- **`CC-26-022` (in impact assessment):** It proposes raising the target MOI to 8.0 TU/cell to improve %CAR+. That is outside the PPQ-001 range of 4–6, so it would need PPQ coverage.
- **`CC-26-004` (PV2.0, closed):** It changed the process and the pFMEA (`RA-PFMEA-001`). All PPQ batches ran on PV2.0.

content.text:
The chain for %CAR+ is mostly intact, but it has three weak points. The EMS alarm-escalation requirement has stale verification. The timing risk has no test evidence. The open ENG deviation probably has the wrong root cause. All five PPQ batches passed.

**1. Attribute and measurement**
- %CAR+ is `FC-CAR`, a CQA in the semantic layer's `transduction_efficiency` entity. It is not the day-5 in-process value.
- Method `AM-FC-CAR` is flow cytometry, with a validated range of 5–90 % of CD3+ and status VALIDATED.
- Protocol `AMV-FC-CAR-01` (approved 2026-03-02, report approved) validated it. Its test case `TC-AMV-CAR-01` is SCRIPTED and covers 5–90 %. Execution `TX-0086` passed on 2026-03-20.
- The PPQ range of 36–45 % and the ENG results of 12–20 % all sit inside the validated range.

**2. Parameters that drive it**

| Parameter | Criticality | PPQ-001 criterion | PPQ batch values |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI | CPP | 4–6 TU/cell | 5.0 on every batch |
| Time from activation to transduction | CPP | 20–30 h | 21.9–23.7 h |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none | not evaluated |

- PPQ-001 criterion 8 is %CAR+ ≥ 20 % of CD3+.
- Vector storage temperature has no PPQ criterion, so it is a gap in PPQ coverage.

**3. Risks, controls and test evidence**

| Risk | Rating | Mitigated by | Test evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FM-06` MOI below target | HIGH, sev 8 | `URS-EBR-007` (vector volume calculation) and `SOP-MFG-104` | Verified: `TC-OQ-EBR-04` (SCRIPTED) passed as `TX-0083` on 2026-03-17, with no later change control. |
| `FM-07` vector held above −70 °C | HIGH, sev 8 | `URS-ULT-001`, `URS-ULT-002`, `URS-EMS-014`, `SOP-MAT-401` | `URS-ULT-001` and `URS-ULT-002` are verified (see below). `URS-EMS-014` is stale. |
| `FM-08` transduction outside 20–30 h | MEDIUM, sev 6 | `SOP-MFG-104` only | None. No requirement or test case is linked. |
| `FM-15` OOS result not flagged | HIGH, sev 10 | `URS-LIMS-002`, `URS-LIMS-003` | Verified: `TC-OQ-LIMS-02` (`TX-0074`) and `TC-OQ-LIMS-03` (`TX-0075`) passed in February 2026, with no change control. |

- **ULT freezer requirements:** The OQ and PQ test cases are `TC-OQ-ULT-01`, `TC-OQ-ULT-02` and `TC-PQ-ULT-01`. Compressor replacement `CC-26-014` on `FRZ-80-02` was implemented on 2026-04-23. The OQ was re-run on 2026-04-24 and passed (`TX-0091`, `TX-0092`). That makes both requirements currently verified.
- **Weak spot in the ULT evidence:** The loaded-mapping PQ for `FRZ-80-02` (`TX-0044`, 2026-02-12) predates the compressor replacement and has not been repeated.
- **`URS-EMS-014` (escalation to on-call within 15 min):** Its only test, `TC-OQ-EMS-04` (`TX-0070`), passed on 2026-01-20. `CC-26-011` changed the escalation configuration (`CS-EMS-03`) on 2026-03-16 and declared "no re-testing required". The last pass therefore predates the change, so the verification is stale. This is a HIGH-risk requirement (`FRA-027`).
- **`FM-08`:** The only control is `SOP-MFG-104` and the batch-record timing check. PPQ-001 does measure the timing (criterion 5), so there is PPQ data but no verification test.

**4. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, execution complete, report pending)**

| Batch | %CAR+ | VCN per CAR+ cell (≤ 5.0) | Vector lot |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PPQ26-01` | 44.6 | 2.39 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-02` | 39.2 | 2.23 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-03` | 36.1 | 1.79 | `LV26-007` |
| `PPQ26-04` | 38.9 | 1.87 | `LV26-021` |
| `PPQ26-05` | 37.3 | 2.22 | `LV26-021` |

- All five met the ≥ 20 % criterion and all VCN results passed.
- The calculated effective MOI is 5.00 on every PPQ and ENG batch. That calculation uses the CoA titer, so it can't show a loss of potency.

**5. Related deviations and what connects them**
- **`DEV-26-021` (MAJOR, closed):** The `FRZ-80-02` compressor failed.
  - The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40 by warehouse staff, about 11 h later. The EMS requirement is 15 min.
  - The historian shows the chamber warming from about −71 °C to −36 °C before the contents were moved to `FRZ-80-01` at 15:30.
  - The deviation resulted in `CAPA-26-008`, which was implemented by `CC-26-014`.
  - The alarm response is the same function as the stale `URS-EMS-014`. `CC-26-011` rebuilt the escalation groups five weeks earlier with no re-test.
  - The deviation has no link to any lot, and no lot was put on hold.
- **`DEV-26-027` (ATYPICAL_RESULT, open) and `CAPA-26-016`:** `ENG26-01` (19.8 %) and `ENG26-02` (11.9 %) came in low. `ENG26-03` (13.9 %) was also low but isn't named in the deviation.
  - The stated cause is donor variability.
  - All three ENG runs used vector lot `LV25-118`, which was stored in `FRZ-80-02`.
  - The PPQ batches used lots stored in `FRZ-80-01`.
  - Donor CD3 does not explain the difference. `PPQ26-04` had the lowest CD3 (50.1 %) and still gave 38.9 % CAR+.
  - A more likely cause is potency loss in `LV25-118` from the `DEV-26-021` excursion. Its CoA titer (104 × 10⁶ TU/mL) was not re-tested. This is my inference from the data, not something the records state, and it should be investigated.
